subject: general
question: Seven boxes A, B, C, D, E, F and G are kept one over the other but not necessarily in the same order. No box is kept above F. Only three boxes are kept between F and E. Only one box is kept between G and C. C is kept immediately above E. Only four boxes are kept between G and A. B is kept at some place above D. How many boxes are kept above E?
solution:
Seven boxes A, B, C, D, E, F and G are kept one over the other but not necessarily in the same order.

 
• No box is kept above F.
 
• Only three boxes are kept between F and E.
 
• Only one box is kept between G and C.
 
• C is kept immediately above E.
 
• Only four boxes are kept between G and A.
 
• B is kept at some place above D.

The Final Arrangement is,

 
 

 
 
F

 
 
 

 
 
G

 
 
 

 
 
B

 
 
 

 
 
C

 
 
 

 
 
E

 
 
 

 
 
D

 
 
 

 
 
A

 
 
 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2"**
